scope: Make the mobile Search3 entry and edit form readable and touch-safe without changing search values or transport.
root_cause: The mobile form inherited 9px labels, 11px primary controls, 40px fields and a 12px/40px submit action; these values reduced readability and could trigger iOS input zoom.
change: Mobile field labels are at least 12px and primary inputs are 16px
Primary controls, submit and advanced-filter action are at least 48px high
Quick filters and tourist selectors retain at least 44px touch targets
The tourist popover offset follows the taller summary control
Exact artifact CI now asserts entry geometry at 375, 760 and 761px
protected_contracts: Eight public paths, form values, URL/payload, price arithmetic, Tourvisor/API, lead transport/mapping, Metrika/goals and the canonical logo are unchanged.

verification.local: Owner validators, exact source build/check, 13 source-build tests, 24 presentation tests with one PHP-only skip, isolation, JS/CSS printing and browser-test syntax passed. Local PHP and Chromium execution were unavailable.

deferred: Physical iPhone and Safari safe-area acceptance
Live current-source interaction and visual inspection
next_action: Add immediate, accessible local-filter feedback and a recoverable zero-results state in the single DS2 owner; accumulate before the next isolated preview publication.
